source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: TestMsgMboxRead.cpp uses the TestMsgMboxRead suite with PascalCase case names such as Basics, OddCases, and LongMessage. Its run comment uses ./mach gtest "TestMsgMboxRead.*". Follow this local native mailbox test naming so the documented filter selects the suite. This is a scoped pattern from the current file, not a claim that every Thunderbird test framework uses the same naming.
title: Keep native mailbox GTest suites aligned with their test file names
